escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_underscores\":false}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
